page.overview:
What is Variags?

The Variags were Men from the land of Khand in southeastern Middle-earth.

J.R.R. Tolkien does not describe the Variags closely in any published work.

Little about the Variags is told apart from that they fought for Sauron and his allies. In the year TA 1944, the Easterling war band known as the Wainriders came to the south of Mordor and recruited Variags and Haradrim, using their numbers to carry out an assault on Gondor during the Wars of the Wainriders.

Hundreds of years later on March 14 - 15 of TA 3019, the Variags fought in the Morgul-host against Gondor at the Battle of the Pelennor Fields.
